crossRefs.note: Yahweh was with Jehoshaphat, because he walked in the first ways of his father David, and didn’t seek the Baals,
Asa did that which was good and right in Yahweh his God’s eyes;
Asa cried to Yahweh his God, and said, “Yahweh, there is no one besides you to help, between the mighty and him who has…
Asa did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes, as David his father did.
At that time Hanani the seer came to Asa king of Judah, and said to him, “Because you have relied on the king of Syria…
For I have kept the ways of Yahweh, and have not wickedly departed from my God.
The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit. He has ceased to be wise and to do good.

parallels.note: Asa did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes, as David his father did.
He walked in all the way of Asa his father. He didn’t turn away from it, doing that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes.…

people.name: Asa
people.line: King of Judah, son of Abijah; father of Jehoshaphat

translations.web: He walked in the way of Asa his father, and didn’t turn away from it, doing that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes.
translations.bsb: And Jehoshaphat walked in the way of his father Asa and did not turn away from it; he did what was right in the eyes of the LORD.
translations.kjv: And he walked in the way of Asa his father, and departed not from it, doing that which was right in the sight of the LORD.
translations.asv: And he walked in the way of Asa his father, and turned not aside from it, doing that which was right in the eyes of Jehovah.
